calibration.note: Personality coefficients in _PROFILES appear manually tuned for character differentiation. Do not describe them as scientifically derived unless separate evidence is published.

models.name: Emotional Continuity State Model
models.purpose: Accumulate per-agent continuous affect so Codec replies track history instead of one-shot mood lines.
models.implementation: continuity/emotional_continuity.py
models.vector_form: E(t) = [irritation, jealousy, hurt, trust, attachment, confidence, anxiety] with auxiliary apology_credibility, rival_heat, counters

blend_rule.name: _blend(current, delta, inertia)
blend_rule.positive_delta: gain = delta * (0.78 + 0.22 * (1 - inertia * 0.25)); new = clamp(current + gain)
blend_rule.notes: Hostile events accrue more readily; repair is attenuated by inertia.

time_decay.rule: decay = decay_per_neutral * steps; I,J,H,X -= decay; C += (0.75 - C) * 0.04 * steps

models.name: Personality Parameter Vector
models.implementation: _PROFILES in emotional_continuity.py
models.vector_form: P = [comparison_sensitivity, rejection_sensitivity, loyalty_weight, anger_inertia, jealousy_inertia, attachment_inertia, trust_recovery, trust_damage, disengage_threshold, decay_per_neutral]

models.name: Agent Relationship Formula 5
models.purpose: Bounded agent↔agent relationship strength with slow drift to neutral
models.implementation: continuity/relationship.py
models.directionality: Directed edges (from_id → to_id); asymmetric by construction

models.name: User Bond Formula RB
models.purpose: Persona→user emotional bond distinct from Formula 5 org relationships
models.implementation: learning/user_relationship_engine.py
models.notes: Archetype defaults exist (e.g. reverent_devotion, trusted_operator_confidant). Full archetype table lives in source; Engineering lists dimensions and constants only.

models.name: Jealousy / Comparison Pathway
models.purpose: Map comparison/insult events into jealousy and rival_heat
models.rule_set: Conditional on classified turn kind == comparison|insult; not a single closed-form J = f(...) for all inputs

models.name: Trust Gain/Loss
models.recovery: genuine_repair: T += trust_recovery * (0.55 + 0.45 * apology_credibility) * 0.35; cooperative adds trust_recovery * 0.18
models.notes: trust_recovery << 1 and albedo trust_recovery=0.22 → regain slower than many damage events

models.name: Attachment
models.purpose: Slow relational bond dimension in E(t)
models.notes: Default attachment higher for albedo (0.78). attachment_inertia in profile; detailed attachment growth equations beyond defaults/events are source-defined per event branch.

models.name: Rival Heat
models.update: On comparison with detected rival alias: heat[r] = clamp(heat[r] + 0.22)
